record.paper_title: Graph Partitions: Recent Progresses and Some Open Problems
record.original_question: For each integer k at least 1, what is the smallest constant c(k) such that every graph G with minimum degree delta(G) at least k has a bisection (S, T) for which both induced subgraphs G[S] and G[T] contain at most c(k)e(G) edges?

evidence.quote: Balanced bipartition is usually referred to as bisection.
Problem 3.2[13, Problem 7] What is the smallest constant c(k) such that every graph G with δ(G) ≥ k has a bisection of which each vertex class induces at most c(k)e(G) edges?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite simple graph with $e(G)=|E|$ edges and minimum degree $\delta(G)$. A bisection of $G$ is an ordered partition $(S,T)$ of $V$ into two disjoint sets with $||S|-|T||\le 1$. For a vertex set $X\subseteq V$, write $e(X)$ for the number of edges of $G$ with both endpoints in $X$.

For each integer $k\ge 1$, determine the smallest constant $c(k)$ with the following property: every graph $G$ with $\delta(G)\ge k$ admits a bisection $(S,T)$ such that
$$\max\{e(S),\,e(T)\}\le c(k)\,e(G).$$
artifact.status_search_result: Work by Lee–Loh–Sudakov and subsequent papers (including a note in the Bulletin of the Australian Mathematical Society and the article "On judicious bisections of graphs") provide upper bounds of the form $c(k)\le 1/4 - \Omega(1/k)$ that are asymptotically tight as $k\to\infty$, but the exact value of $c(k)$ for each fixed $k\ge 1$ is not determined. The problem is generally cited as still open.

status_evidence.title: On judicious bisections of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes bounds on max{e(V1),e(V2)} for bisections of graphs with given minimum degree, with asymptotically tight estimates.
status_evidence.claim: Partial bounds on c(k) are known but the exact extremal constant is not pinned down.

status_evidence.title: A note on judicious bisections of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Improves bounds on judicious bisections for graphs with large minimum degree.
status_evidence.claim: Further refinements exist but the exact constant c(k) remains undetermined.

status_evidence.title: Bisections of graphs (Lee, Loh, Sudakov)
status_evidence.snippet: Provides judicious bisection results conditioned on minimum degree.
status_evidence.claim: Results give asymptotic, not exact, values of c(k).
